summary: The Dallas dossiers are largely accurate on the CURRENT FACTS (coach, front office, 26-56, Cup group, trade moves, Specter exclusion) but had patterns of error: Dallas's opener was assumed to be Oct 20, Cup cadence was overstated (Dallas plays four group games, not five Fridays), the State Fair was said to overlap the opening weeks, Nike-facing footwear hooks ignored that Flagg (New Balance) and Irving (Anta) are outside Nike, and several small details were fixed (Badu hometown, Jim Jackson, Kessler location, Mavs Ball and Mavs Ballers vocabulary, Sweet Georgia Brown removed). Live checks confirmed Trees and Kettle Art. The strategy brief needs edits on the Cup cadence and opener date; the City Edition history, door-level retail and small-venue status remain the main unverified items.
